name: Forbidden Confessions: Nanny
source:
My Nanny Experience entails the confession story of Agatha, a 19-year-old high school graduating student who took the job as a babysitter due to financial needs.

Willing to do anything to save enough money for college, Agatha found herself tangled in a series of encounters and affairs with Mr. Grant and her step brother Andrew.

This is supposed to be a casual babysitting part-time job... until it wasn't.

[From [url=https://strange-girl-studios.itch.io/forbidden-confessions-nanny]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《我的保姆经历》讲述了19岁的高中毕业生阿加莎的自白故事，她因经济需要而接受了保姆的工作。

阿加莎愿意做任何事情来攒足够的钱上大学，但她发现自己陷入了与格兰特先生和她的继兄弟安德鲁的一系列遭遇和风流韵事中。

这本来应该是一份临时的保姆兼职工作……直到事实并非如此。

[来自[url=https://strange-girl-studios.itch.io/forbidden-confessions-nanny]Itch.io[/url]]
